verdict.rationale: PostHog's docs describe operating the product via natural-language prompts through its official MCP server/AI editor integration — shipping feature flags, running HogQL queries, triaging tickets, and pulling stack traces 'with just plain text questions,' backed by a documented MCP server and CLI usable by coding agents. missing for 10: independent/hands-on user confirmation that natural-language MCP commands work reliably in practice beyond vendor docs.
